verdicts.aoc: You'd wear Tax the Rich to the richest party in town and call it praxis.
verdicts.newsom: You wrote the rules, then got a table at the French Laundry anyway.
verdicts.shapiro: You do everything right, get passed over anyway, and smile while you start the list.
verdicts.harris: You would lose, and then publish a book explaining whose fault it was.
verdicts.buttigieg: You have a McKinsey slide for every feeling and you'd present it on Fox.
verdicts.beshear: You're so inoffensive that even the nepotism feels wholesome.
verdicts.slotkin: You answer every question like it's a CIA briefing and nobody else is cleared.
verdicts.pritzker: You fight for the working class from a mansion with the toilets taken out.
verdicts.kelly: You have been to space, and you still cannot make a room look up.
verdicts.khanna: You denounce the oligarchs on behalf of the district where they all live.
verdicts.ossoff: You'd ban Congress from trading stocks. Enjoy eating lunch alone.
verdicts.vance: You called your boss unfit, took the job, and now ask guests if they said thank you.
verdicts.rubio: You hold four jobs at once and opinions for exactly as long as they're useful.
verdicts.desantis: You would pick a fight with a cartoon mouse and lose the room before your launch had finished loading.
verdicts.kemp: You said no to the boss once and have been quietly dining out on it ever since.
verdicts.christie: You'd close the beach to everyone and then get photographed sunbathing on it.
verdicts.trumpjr: You were born on third base and host a podcast about how you hit a triple.
verdicts.youngkin: You're private equity in a fleece vest: the layoffs come with a warm smile.
verdicts.randpaul: You inherited your anti-establishment politics from your dad, the congressman.
verdicts.cruz: You would endorse the man who insulted your family and call it strategy.
verdicts.ramaswamy: You think the country's problem is too many prom queens and not enough you.
verdicts.pence: You would certify the result, lose everything for it, and still decline to dine alone with the reporter.
verdicts.hawley: You raise a fist when the cameras are on and keep your running shoes by the door.

og.title: US Political Quiz: Which 2028 candidate are you, really?
og.description: 23 candidates. One unflattering verdict. Find your 2028 match, then argue about it with everyone you know.
